sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraud following an undocumented coordinated pattern on card C06220-K1 held by customer C06220 (internal case AC-HHF-002, opened 2017-01-19). Between 2017-01-17 and 2017-01-19 the card was used for 3 transaction(s) totalling $2,166.71: on 2017-01-17 $637.13 online in billing region 330.0; on 2017-01-18 $758.80 online in billing region 384.0; on 2017-01-19 $770.78 online in billing region 126.0. The activity matches a coordinated undocumented wave across 14 cards sharing the signature (ProductCD='C' + DeviceType='mobile' + device_new='New' + IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS + spoofed OS/UA wave). The other connected cards in this wave are C00450-K1, C02342-K1, C05061-K1, C05704-K2, C05770-K1, C06962-K2, C07212-K2, C07925-K1, C07997-K1, C09251-K1, C10553-K1, C11309-K1, C11543-K2. The activity was identified from the bank's graph of shared devices and prior cases rather than from a customer report. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history (prior median purchase $107.92). No prior report has been filed on this customer. OFAC SDN screening of the customer identifier: no match (anonymised identifiers; screening result recorded from the sdn.csv lookup in the live run). Recommended actions: a block and reissue of the card, not yet done and awaiting team-lead approval, internal case opened, 13 connected cards placed under monitoring, case escalated to an analyst.
